text:
Tara Nguyen: Quick sync — product wants to make unversioned keys prefer v2. Need a short safety checklist: per-route pins, shadow sampling, quota preview, and circuit breakers.
Omar Reyes: +1 for per-route pins. /v1/embeddings and /v1/rerank are wire-sensitive.
Lilly Chen: For the console: migration preview card with per-route estimated token delta, p95 latency delta, and a small sample of diffed outputs. Add a "Run shadow" button.
sre-bot: Alert suggestion: tenant_fallback_rate > 0.5% for 10m -> page and disable auto-switch for that tenant. Global fallback_rate > 0.25% for 2m -> page and pause rollout.
Omar Reyes: Shadow defaults: sample_pct=0.1 per-route for 24h. Emit metrics: redwood.migration.shadow.{tenant,route}.v1_count,v2_count,fallback_count,token_delta_p95. Tag with shadow_run_id and cohort.
Tara Nguyen: Routing precedence: 1) explicit headers (x-api-version/x-client-version), 2) token metadata (pinned), 3) tenant compat setting, 4) global default. Auto-switch only for tokens with no explicit version and not pinned.
Lilly Chen: Billing: quota-service should accept a shadow_estimate so console shows estimated monthly cost delta. Add audit log for tenant opt-in/out.
Omar Reyes: Fallback policy: if client requests v1 and v1 overloaded, return 503 unless tenant set compat.auto_fallback=true; then route to v2-compat and emit x-compat-mode: fallback on response.
sre-bot: Recommended throttle formula: throttle_pct = min(15, fallback_rate * 8).
Tara Nguyen: Action items: Omar - route-manager enum + header precedence (due Thu). Lilly - console preview mock + audit flow (due Wed). SRE - runbook & thresholds (due Tue). I'll draft the RFC.
Lilly Chen: I'll include gentle banner copy: "We plan to route unversioned requests to newer models. Preview impact before switching."
Omar Reyes: I'll also add SDK note to tolerate unknown fields.
Tara Nguyen: Thanks — let's reconvene after the first 24h staging shadow.
